text_en: When the day of Pentecost had come, they were all together in one place.
text_cn: 五旬节日一到，众人都聚集一处。

text_en: And suddenly from heaven there came a sound like the rush of a violent wind, and it filled the entire house where they were sitting.
text_cn: 忽然，从天上来了一阵响声，好像暴风刮来，充满了他们所在的全座房屋。

text_en: Divided tongues, as of fire, appeared among them, and a tongue rested on each of them.
text_cn: 有些散开好像火的舌头，停留在他们每人头上，

text_en: All of them were filled with the Holy Spirit and began to speak in other languages, as the Spirit gave them ability.
text_cn: 众人都充满了圣神，照圣神赐给他们的话，说起外方话来。

text_en: Now there were devout Jews from every nation under heaven living in Jerusalem.
text_cn: 那时，居住在耶路撒冷的，有从天下各国来的虔诚的犹太人。

text_en: And at this sound the crowd gathered and was bewildered, because each one heard them speaking in the native language of each.
text_cn: 这声音一响，就聚来了许多人，都仓惶失措，因为人人都听见他们说自己的方言。

text_en: Amazed and astonished, they asked, “Are not all these who are speaking Galileans?
text_cn: 他们惊讶奇怪地说：“看，这些说话的不都是加里肋亚人吗？

text_en: And how is it that we hear, each of us, in our own native language?
text_cn: 怎么我们每人听见他们说我们出生地的方言呢？

text_en: Parthians, Medes, Elamites, and residents of Mesopotamia, Judea and Cappadocia, Pontus and Asia,
text_cn: 我们中有帕提雅人、玛待人、厄蓝人和居住在美索不达米亚、犹太及卡帕多细雅、本都并亚细亚、

text_en: Phrygia and Pamphylia, Egypt and the parts of Libya belonging to Cyrene, and visitors from Rome, both Jews and proselytes,
text_cn: 夫黎基雅和旁非里雅、埃及并靠近基勒乃的利比亚一带的人，以及侨居的罗马人、

text_en: Cretans and Arabs—in our own languages we hear them speaking about God’s deeds of power. ”
text_cn: 犹太人和归依犹太教的人、克里特人和阿剌伯人，怎么我们都听见他们用我们的话，讲论天主的奇事呢？”

text_en: All were amazed and perplexed, saying to one another, “What does this mean? ”
text_cn: 众人都惊讶犹豫，彼此说：“这是什么事？”

text_en: But others sneered and said, “They are filled with new wine. ”
text_cn: 另有些人却讥笑说：“他们喝醉了酒！”

text_en: But Peter, standing with the eleven, raised his voice and addressed them, “Men of Judea and all who live in Jerusalem, let this be known to you, and listen to what I say.
text_cn: 伯多禄就同十一位宗徒站起来，高声向他们说：“犹太人和所有居住在耶路撒冷的人！请你们留意，侧耳静听我的话！

text_en: Indeed, these are not drunk, as you suppose, for it is only nine o’clock in the morning.
text_cn: 这些人并不像你们所设想的喝醉了，因为才是白天第三时辰；

text_en: No, this is what was spoken through the prophet Joel:
text_cn: 反而这是藉岳厄尔先知所预言的：

text_en: ‘In the last days it will be, God declares, that I will pour out my Spirit upon all flesh, and your sons and your daughters shall prophesy, and your young men shall see visions, and your old men shall dream dreams.
text_cn: ‘末日──天主说──我要将我的神倾注在所有有血肉的人身上，你们的儿子和女儿都要说预言，青年人要见异像，老年人要看梦境。

text_en: Even upon my slaves, both men and women, in those days I will pour out my Spirit; and they shall prophesy.
text_cn: 甚至在那些日子里，连在我的仆人和我的婢女身上，我也要倾注我的神；他们要讲预言。

text_en: And I will show portents in the heaven above and signs on the earth below, blood, and fire, and smoky mist.
text_cn: 我要在天上显示奇迹，在下地显示征兆：血、火和烟气。

text_en: The sun shall be turned to darkness and the moon to blood, before the coming of the Lord’s great and glorious day.
text_cn: 在上主的伟大和显赫的日子来临以前，太阳要变成昏暗，月亮要变成血红。

text_en: Then everyone who calls on the name of the Lord shall be saved. ’
text_cn: 将来，凡呼号上主名字的人，必然获救。’

text_en: “You that are Israelites, listen to what I have to say: Jesus of Nazareth, a man attested to you by God with deeds of power, wonders, and signs that God did through him among you, as you yourselves know—
text_cn: 诸位以色列人！请听这些话：纳匝肋人耶稣是天主用德能、奇迹和征兆──即天主藉他在你们中所行的，一如你们所知道的──给你们证明了的人。

text_en: this man, handed over to you according to the definite plan and foreknowledge of God, you crucified and killed by the hands of those outside the law.
text_cn: 他照天主已定的计划和预知，被交付了；你们藉着不法者的手，钉他在十字架上，杀死了他；

text_en: But God raised him up, having freed him from death, because it was impossible for him to be held in its power.
text_cn: 天主却解除了他死亡的苦痛，使他复活了，因为他不能受死亡的控制，

text_en: For David says concerning him, ‘I saw the Lord always before me, for he is at my right hand so that I will not be shaken;
text_cn: 因为达味指着他说：‘我常将上主置于我眼前；我决不动摇，因他在我右边。

text_en: therefore my heart was glad, and my tongue rejoiced; moreover my flesh will live in hope.
text_cn: 因此，我心欢乐，我的舌愉快，连我的肉身也要安息于希望中，

text_en: For you will not abandon my soul to Hades, or let your Holy One experience corruption.
text_cn: 因为你决不会将我的灵魂遗弃在阴府，也不会让你的圣者见到腐朽。

text_en: You have made known to me the ways of life; you will make me full of gladness with your presence. ’
text_cn: 你要将生命的道路指示给我，要在你面前用喜乐充满我。’

text_en: “Fellow Israelites, I may say to you confidently of our ancestor David that he both died and was buried, and his tomb is with us to this day.
text_cn: 诸位仁人弟兄！容我坦白对你们讲论圣祖达味的事罢！他死了，也埋葬了，他的坟墓直到今天还在我们这里。

text_en: Since he was a prophet, he knew that God had sworn with an oath to him that he would put one of his descendants on his throne.
text_cn: 他既是先知，也知道天主曾以誓词对他起了誓，要从他的子嗣中立一位来坐他的御座。

text_en: Foreseeing this, David spoke of the resurrection of the Messiah, saying, ‘He was not abandoned to Hades, nor did his flesh experience corruption. ’
text_cn: 他既预见了，就论及默西亚的复活说：‘他没有被遗弃在阴府，他的肉身也没有见到腐朽。’

text_en: This Jesus God raised up, and of that all of us are witnesses.
text_cn: 这位耶稣，天主使他复活了，我们都是他的见证人。

text_en: Being therefore exalted at the right hand of God, and having received from the Father the promise of the Holy Spirit, he has poured out this that you both see and hear.
text_cn: 他被举扬到天主的右边，由父领受了所恩许的圣神；你们现今所见所闻的，就是他所倾注的圣神。

text_en: For David did not ascend into the heavens, but he himself says, ‘The Lord said to my Lord, “Sit at my right hand,
text_cn: 达味本来没有升到天上，但是他却说：‘上主对吾主说：你坐在我右边，

text_en: until I make your enemies your footstool. ”’
text_cn: 等我使你的仇敌，变作你脚的踏板。’

text_en: Therefore let the entire house of Israel know with certainty that God has made him both Lord and Messiah, this Jesus whom you crucified. ”
text_cn: 所以，以色列全家应确切知道：天主已把你们所钉死的这位耶稣，立为主，立为默西亚了。”

text_en: Now when they heard this, they were cut to the heart and said to Peter and to the other apostles, “Brothers, what should we do? ”
text_cn: 他们一听见这些话，就心中刺痛，遂向伯多禄和其他宗徒说：“诸位仁人弟兄！我们该作什么？”

text_en: Peter said to them, “Repent, and be baptized every one of you in the name of Jesus Christ so that your sins may be forgiven; and you will receive the gift of the Holy Spirit.
text_cn: 伯多禄便对他们说：“你们悔改罢！你们每人要以耶稣基督的名字受洗，好赦免你们的罪过，并领受圣神的恩惠。

text_en: For the promise is for you, for your children, and for all who are far away, everyone whom the Lord our God calls to him. ”
text_cn: 因为这恩许就是为了你们和你们的子女，以及一切远方的人，因为都是我们的上主天主所召叫的。”

text_en: And he testified with many other arguments and exhorted them, saying, “Save yourselves from this corrupt generation. ”
text_cn: 他还讲了很多别的作证的话，并劝他们说：“你们应救自己脱离这邪恶的世代。”

text_en: So those who welcomed his message were baptized, and that day about three thousand persons were added.
text_cn: 于是，凡接受他的话的人，都受了洗；在那一天约增添了三千人。

text_en: They devoted themselves to the apostles’ teaching and fellowship, to the breaking of bread and the prayers.
text_cn: 他们专心听取宗徒的训诲，时常团聚，擘饼，祈祷。

text_en: Awe came upon everyone, because many wonders and signs were being done by the apostles.
text_cn: 因为宗徒显了许多奇迹异事，每人都怀着敬畏之情。

text_en: All who believed were together and had all things in common;
text_cn: 凡信了的人，常齐集一处，一切所有皆归公用。

text_en: they would sell their possessions and goods and distribute the proceeds to all, as any had need.
text_cn: 他们把产业和财物变卖，按照每人的需要分配。

text_en: Day by day, as they spent much time together in the temple, they broke bread at home and ate their food with glad and generous hearts,
text_cn: 每天都成群结队地前往圣殿，也挨户擘(bāi)饼，怀着欢乐和诚实的心一起进食。

text_en: praising God and having the goodwill of all the people. And day by day the Lord added to their number those who were being saved.
text_cn: 他们常赞颂天主，也获得了全民众的爱戴；上主天天使那些得救的人加入会众。
